_doc: MINIMAL decisive rerun of the checkpoint-fix A/B (the full wal-checkpoint-fix-ab was aborted before the fix arms reached 100k). Only the missing measurement: syncfs and both at 100k streams, ladder [2,4]. Known reference points from the aborted run: baseline@100k = 10.4k ops/s at p2 degrading to 7.3k at p8 (the cliff); baseline/stagger@10k ~107-111k (fixes don't regress below the cliff). Verdict rule: if syncfs/both peak >> 10.4k the fix works. Requires MULTILANE=1 SERVER_LOCAL_SSD_BLOCK=1 SPOT_SERVER=1. Image: europe-west1-docker.pkg.dev/vaxine/ds-bench/durable-streams:dev (digest 2ebed436* = perf/wal-syncfs @ 394375168, both flags compiled in, default off).
